ns2:section.sectionText: Description: In this course we explore the history of the British Isles, c. 1450 – 1800: the period from the end of the Middle Ages through the end of the first Global Age. We use primary sources to understand the enormous changes experienced by the people of the of the "four Kingdoms" of England, Scotland, Wales, and Ireland in these centuries, focusing on British connections with Continental Europe, and British expansion into the wider world.
